blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: Inside the sealed crate, packed in wax-paper and reassurance, sits a heavy grey stone the size of a loaf, warm to the touch, faintly humming, with a light deep inside it that is slowly going out.

blocks.label: Maker Voice
blocks.body: EMERIS CROWN HOLDINGS: Your Asset, Handled With Care. Fully insured against loss, theft, and most acts of god. Please do not open, touch, tilt, comfort, or speak to your Asset.

blocks.label: At The Table
blocks.body: Reach the Whitefire Custodian and the Open Vale ritual. Sensing what it truly is uses Instinct 15 when the fiction supports it.
